title: Cut fruit

provenance.alignment: Original fixed frame-0 rigid sim-to-demo alignment; no per-frame fitting.
provenance.stages: graph: archived SLSQP seed; ft: object-aware fine-tuning; rl: recorded DexOAK Allegro policy. Inspire baseline RL deliberately excluded.

optimization.label: Single-frame graph re-solve
optimization.note: Actual SLSQP iterates of the normalized graph objective with joint and wrist bounds; illustrative diagnostic, not the complete seed-generation loss.

renderingNote: Restyled robot materials; dense rigid visual meshes decimated to at most 5k faces/link or 16k faces/object part. Human mesh correspondence and all state trajectories preserved.
graphNote: Reconstructed Delaunay graph; 32 fixed surface anchors per object, for legibility.
